summary.text: David Moon is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 20, where he has served since January 14, 2015, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Moon was elected House Majority Leader for the 2023-2024 session.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments as the Legislative Policy Committee, Joint Federal Action Oversight Committee, Audit and Evaluation Committee, Judiciary Committee, and Rules & Executive Nominations Committee.
